findings.requirement: Exact source, parent lineage and bounded public stage route
findings.finding: The bounded controller validates current authority parents, invokes the retained LAFEA.3 stage boundary and registers mesh/execution/recovery/convergence lineage. Bucket-01 still needs one aggregate report exposing the required explicit qualification states rather than only an aggregate PASS/BLOCKED result.
The repository retains exact-head gate infrastructure, but issue #269 records exact-current-main executable PASS as false. Connector inspection is not executable qualification evidence.

findings.requirement: Deterministic bounded production T6 mesh ladder
findings.finding: The selected concentric annular geometry has deterministic L1/L2/L3 T6 generation, analytic circumferential midside placement, shared edge identities, counter-clockwise elements, feature sets and distinct mesh hashes.

Current generated quality records area error and boundary-node radius error. Bucket-01 additionally requires perimeter error, full mapped-boundary deviation, reconstructed hole-centre error, critical-ligament error, symmetry error and explicit quadratic midside deviation evidence.

findings.requirement: Element validity at corners, integration points and mapped-edge sampling
findings.finding: Positive scaled Jacobian and integration-point determinant checks exist, with rejection of non-counter-clockwise generation. Dense mapped-element sampling, explicit disconnected-region checks, duplicate-coordinate checks and qualification receipts for coverage must be added or proven by existing contracts.

The T6 element check covers axis-aligned, distorted and obtuse elements, rotation, translation and scaling invariance, plane stress/plane strain and non-positive Jacobian rejection at a 1e-10 relative criterion.

findings.requirement: T3 assembled patch through governed route
findings.finding: An assembled two-triangle patch verifies traction/nodal parity, sign reversal, scaling, stress and equilibrium, but uses a 1e-7 scaled comparison and directly invokes the local continuum core. Bucket-01 requires frozen 1e-8 authority, every integration point, strain energy, orientation/node-order anti-drift and retained public-route evidence.

The core certification states pure-shear, principal and von Mises coverage, but Bucket-01 needs a separately identified frozen benchmark proving engineering-versus-tensor shear convention and local/global orientation through the governed evidence route.

findings.requirement: Plane-stress cantilever or manufactured panel with three-level convergence
findings.finding: No dedicated LAFEA.3 cantilever or manufactured rectangular-panel benchmark was identified in the current exact-head script set.

findings.requirement: Load-driven free-DOF solve and force equilibrium
findings.finding: NB-T6D requires nonzero resultant, BOUNDARY_ZERO restraints, deterministic Cholesky, free DOFs, pivots, retained reactions and force-equilibrium closure.

findings.requirement: Moment equilibrium and strain-energy convergence in production qualification
findings.finding: NB-T6D independently recomputes only force resultants. Its level evidence does not retain moment equilibrium, strain energy, external work or their three-level convergence, despite lower-level solver energy evidence existing elsewhere.

findings.requirement: Integration-point stress authority separated from display
findings.finding: The bounded controller retains non-empty T6 Gauss-point recovery and explicitly requires projectedDisplayHash=null and projectedDisplayRole=NOT_PRODUCED for numerical qualification.

Current engineering stress convergence uses the moving maximum of all retained integration-point von Mises values. It does not bind fixed physical coordinates, angular stations, stress paths or component frames, so mesh movement can change the compared location.

findings.requirement: Dimensionally valid and asymptotic three-level convergence
findings.finding: evaluateLafeaLoadDrivenConvergence divides successive differences by max(1, abs(fine observation)), which introduces a unit-dependent floor. It accepts fine-level change against a tolerance without observed order, Richardson extrapolation, GCI, monotonic/oscillatory classification or asymptotic-range validation.

findings.requirement: T6 Kirsch benchmark matching production recovery route
findings.finding: The retained B7B Kirsch authority is a Q8 quarter-annulus with exact Kirsch traction and contract-only observations. It is valuable independent evidence but does not qualify the production T6 mesh/recovery path at fixed angular and radial probes.

findings.requirement: Frozen governing code and independent code oracle
findings.finding: Current bounded authority intentionally retains assessmentReady=false and codeReady=false. No governing code, edition, allowable source, stress classification or benchmark oracle is frozen.

Canonical hashes, frozen receipts, replay checks and portable evidence structures exist. No executable exact-current-main PASS is available to this audit, and Bucket-01 additionally requires three clean replay observations and one report-data hash covering the new benchmark suite.
